Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2601 of 2023

Applicant :- Girdhar Tiwari
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Naveen Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Learned A.G.A. informs that he has procured complete instructions in the matter including upto
date case diary of the case.
Heard Shri Naveen Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Girdhar Tiwari for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.889 of 2022, under Sections 323, 354, 376, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali Nagar,
District Gonda, during trial.

Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant is aged about 68 years and related to the informant/victim as his father-in-law and he has been falsely implicated in this case only due to the dispute pertaining to the division of immovable properties and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

It is further submitted that the F.I.R. of this case was lodged by the prosecutrix on 05.12.2022 at 01:50pm. by moving a written application alleging that the husband of the victim had died about six months ago from before lodging of the F.I.R. and the instant application (father-in-law) was having a bad eye on her and on 05.12.2022 at about 08:00am. when she was taking bath in the bathroom

,
the applicant molested her.

The victim was medical examined on the same day and three injuries of the nature of abrasions on right forearm, below right clavicle and left forearm were found, however,
she did not permitted her internal medical examination.

In her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she has supported the version of the F.I.R.
Highlighting the above factual matrix, it is vehemently submitted on behalf of the applicant that the informant/victim and the applicant were having bad relations pertaining to the division of immovable properties and in this regard way back on 19.05.2022, an application was moved by the instant applicant to the Superintendent of Police, Gonda, a copy of which was also forwarded to the District Magistrate, Gonda, D.I.G. of Police, Devi Patan Division, Gonda, Commissioner, Devi Patan Division, Gonda and Station House Officer, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, Gonda, a copy of this application has been placed as Annexure No.2 along with receipt of the registry at page no.24.
A compromise was also arrived between the parties at police station on 16.06.2022.

It is further submitted that the prosecutrix was not satisfied with the compromise arrived at between the applicant and her and she filed an application under Section 125 Cr.P.C. on 02.07.2022 in the court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Gonda requesting to grant her maintenance and thereafter she has also instituted a civil suit on 14.07.2022 against the instant applicant requesting for perpetual injunction from alienating the properties mentioned in the suit.
While drawing attention of this Court towards Annexure Nos.6 and 7, which are the reports of the concerned police station dated 30.11.2022 and 05.12.2022 (the day on which the alleged incident of molestation has been alleged)

sentences.text: , it is vehemently submitted that on 30.11.2022 and also on 05.12.2022 the prosecutrix had raised a quarrel on the basis of division of properties and in connivance of the local police station, the instant applicant was arrested on 05.12.2022 at 03:10pm.

Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted that the informant/victim is highly inimical with the instant applicant and by hook or crook she wants to get a share in the properties of the applicant and it is to harass and pressurize the applicant, allegation of molestation and rape has been levelled against the applicant.

In the F.I.R. there is no whisper of rape and the allegations are only pertaining to molestation, while in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
prosecutrix had improved her case to the tune that applicant has also placed his finger in her private part in order to attract the consequences of rape so that the applicant may be pressurized and bow to her terms.
The applicant is an old person aged about 68 years and suffering from various age related ailments.

It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 27.12.2022 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

There is no element of sexual assault and it evident that a small quarrel, which Girdhar Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138243995/
2 had occurred on 05.12.2022 pertaining to which the applicant was also arrested by local police under Section 151 Cr.P.C., the colour of rape has been given.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence with his own daughter-in-law and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is prima facie evident that the parties are highly inimical towards each other.

In the past on various occasions they had quarrelled, which party is at fault could only be determined after full fledged trial, however, it is evident that on 30.11.2022 as well as on 05.12.2022, a quarrel/fight had taken place between the applicant and the informant/victim.

It is evident by the challani reports of the concerned police station dated 30.11.2022 and 05.12.2022 that pertaining to the incident of quarrel/fight occurred on 05.12.2022, the applicant was arrested at about 03:10pm. on 05.12.2022.

There is no whisper in the challani report of the police station concerned submitted under Sections 151, 107, 116 Cr.P.C. of dated 05.12.2022 with regard to the F.I.R. lodged by the informant/victim pertaining to the instant case.

Three injuries have been sustained by the prosecutrix and according to learned counsel for the applicant, the same could not be related with the offence of rape as the prosecutrix had refused to undergo any internal medical examination.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is an old person aged about 68 years and is in jail in this case since 27.12.2022 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

Let the accused/applicant- Girdhar Tiwari involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
